universal.en: Tell me about a moment from this year you keep coming back to.
universal.et: Räägi mulle ühest selle aasta hetkest, mille juurde sa aina tagasi tuled.

universal.en: Who surprised you recently — and what did they do?
universal.et: Kes sind hiljuti üllatas — ja millega?

universal.en: What's something small that made today different from yesterday?
universal.et: Mis väike asi tegi tänase päeva eilsest erinevaks?

universal.en: Tell me about a place you can picture down to the smallest detail.
universal.et: Räägi mulle kohast, mida sa mäletad pisima detailini.

universal.en: What did you almost say to someone today, but didn't?
universal.et: Mida sa täna oleksid peaaegu kellelegi öelnud, aga jätsid ütlemata?

universal.en: What's a smell or sound that takes you straight back somewhere?
universal.et: Mis lõhn või heli viib su otsejoones kuhugi tagasi?

universal.en: Tell me about something you did recently that younger you wouldn't believe.
universal.et: Räägi millestki hiljutisest, mida noorem sina ei usuks.

universal.en: What conversation from this week is still running in your head?
universal.et: Milline selle nädala vestlus käib sul ikka veel peas?

universal.en: What are you quietly proud of right now?
universal.et: Mille üle sa praegu vaikselt uhke oled?

universal.en: Tell me about an object you own that has a story behind it.
universal.et: Räägi mulle ühest oma asjast, millel on lugu taga.

universal.en: What's something you're in the middle of figuring out?
universal.et: Mis on see asi, mille üle sa parasjagu pead murrad?

universal.en: Who do you miss, and what would you tell them right now?
universal.et: Kellest sa puudust tunned ja mida sa talle praegu ütleksid?

universal.en: Tell me about the last time you laughed properly.
universal.et: Räägi mulle viimasest korrast, kui sa päriselt naersid.

universal.en: What's a tiny ritual of yours that nobody else knows about?
universal.et: Mis on sinu väike rituaal, millest keegi teine ei tea?
